usage: The word '堂哥' specifically refers to an older male cousin on your father's side, meaning he is the son of your father's brother.
'堂哥' is used as a noun to identify a family member, and it always refers to an older male cousin, never a younger one or female cousin.
When talking about cousins in Cantonese, you need to distinguish paternal cousins (堂) from maternal cousins (表). '堂哥' must be paternal.
It is polite and common to use '堂哥' when addressing or referring to your father's elder brother's son if he is older than you.
You can use '堂哥' in various sentence structures such as subject position, object position, or with possessive pronouns.

examples.meaning: I go shopping with my older male cousin on my father's side.
